posts.title: CNG Forum Session Recordings Are Now on YouTube
posts.description: Link: www.youtube.com The first batch of session recordings from last month’s CNG Forum are available on YouTube, showcasing the latest and greatest cloud-native geospatial technology and use cases. As of now, 44 recordings are online, with more to follow soon.

posts.title: Tippecanoe Alternative Manby Runs 4.5 Times Faster in an Independent Test
posts.description: Link: birkskyum.github.io (via: bsky.app ) Manby , a new command-line tool for creating vector tiles, promises to be a drop-in replacement for Tippecanoe , while being faster and more memory efficient.
